# Changelog
All versions of the model are documented in this file.

# Version 1.1
Model estimated as a VAR model. This doesn't incorporate an inflation target.

## Variables used for estimating the model

|"ola" variable                 |"ola" variable                 |"ola" variable             |
|-------------------------------|-------------------------------|---------------------------|
|Foreing economic growth        |External public debt           |Exchange rate              | 
|Foreing policy interest rate   |Remittances                    |Country risk premium       |
|Foreing core inflation         |Internal public debt           |Domestic core inflation    |
|Public investment              |Net foreing assets             |Domestic economic growth   |
|Total government revenue       |Net domestic assets            |Private investment         |
|Government operating expenses  |Domestic policy interest rate  |                           |

Due to the VAR system was resulted unstable, the stability of the model was improved by shrinking the coefficients matrix by multiplying that matrix by 0.99^2 until the model was stable.
